capabilities: Edit SVG source with live preview
Select, drag, and resize elements on the canvas
Edit fill, stroke, opacity, size, and text in the inspector
Insert text, rectangle, and circle elements
Create a one-time .svg.bak backup before the first save
disambiguation: Despite the name, this is not an editor for Obsidian Canvas (.canvas) boards; it edits .svg image files.
extras: The README includes a Release section aimed at the developer (GitHub release and lint/build commands). It states the plugin makes no network requests, only reads and writes user-selected SVG files, and notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian only displays SVG files as images; it offers no way to open and edit their markup or elements in place.
summary: Visual SVG editor that opens .svg files from the vault with source, layers, canvas, and inspector panes.
